boundary: which layer makes a PHP 5.0.0 defect visible: emalloc's cache and 8-byte rounding hide it from any detector at free() (asan-blind, the nested allocator), or efree reaches free() and the libc boundary sees it (temporal-asan-visible). Decided per case by MEASUREMENT: ASan with the allocator patched versus ASan with it as shipped, both run here
title: PHP 5.0.0 memory-safety defects in the engine and ext/standard, as script triggers through the real interpreter, split by whether the Zend allocator hides them
